cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.
